newsitem.title: USA: Caribiner to buy Bauer Audio Visual.
newsitem.headline: Caribiner to buy Bauer Audio Visual.

text.p: Caribiner International Inc said Friday it has a definitive agreement to buy Bauer Audio Visual Inc for $26.3 million.
The company said it will pay for the acquisition with $13.9 million in cash, $4.6 million in Caribiner stock and the assumption of $7.8 million of long-term debt.
Bauer will be integrated into Caribiner's Total Audio Visual Services division, acquired by Caribiner in September 1996, it said. The deal is expected to close in June.

The meetings and conference planning company said the purchase will expand Caribiner's position as a provider of audio and visual equipment services, including hotel audio-visual outsourcing services.
The company also said it has completed the acquisition of Watts-Silverstein Inc. The purchase will result in Caribiner having a digital media communications unit based in Seattle, it said.
Terms of the Watts-Silverstein purchase were not disclosed.
